messages:
alex: Quick sync — want to lock the SI co-sell handoff gates for Q2 (marketplace deals + HW bundles). Goal: make handoff deterministic so reps don't ping us at demo time.

maya: +1. can we include clear ARR thresholds and which marketplace SKUs map to SI-led vs rw-led?

javier: We ran into confusion last week re: HW partner rebates — who owns contract kickoff?

kelly: Proposal: if opportunity includes a certified HW bundle OR marketplace SKU 'redwood-dedicated-1', SI gets primary handoff. Otherwise AE maintains primary unless ARR >= 250k.

alex: That aligns w/what I had in mind. Suggest we encode this as a small decision table and surface it in the intake form.

rachel: +1. also need a rule for joint announcement cadence — SI wants 2 weeks prep for co-branded announce.

partners-bot: Reminder: partnership intake template v0.9 uploaded to Confluence -> https://rwd.atlassian.net/space/PS/partnership-intake (file: intake_v0.9.md) :robot_face:

maya: For ARR threshold exceptions, add a step: AE or SI can request an override with APPROVAL from Partnerships + Sales Ops. Keep approvals in thread.

javier: Practical mapping snippet we can paste into intake:

```
if includes_hw_bundle or sku == 'redwood-dedicated-1':
  owner = 'SI'
elif ARR >= 250000:
  owner = 'SI'
else:
  owner = 'Redwood AE'
```

kelly: Also add: if customer asks for private deployment + on-prem hardware, escalate to Enterprise ops and flag for legal (data residency).

alex: Ok action items: 1) Maya to add decision table to intake form by EOD Wed. 2) Javier to draft co-announcement checklist with SI (2-week timeline). 3) Kelly to add SKU whitelist and HW rebate owner mapping. 4) Rachel to add communication cadence to partnership playbook.

maya: I'll create the intake PR and ping here when ready. tagging @javier @kelly

javier: Will start the co-announce checklist draft and share initial template by tomorrow.

kelly: I'll export SKU list from Commerce and attach to the PR. also will note rebate owner per partner.

rachel: I'll slot a 30m follow-up on Thurs to approve the final gate table.

alex: Great. Last call: anyone object to making the marketplace SKU rule override-only (i.e., explicit opt-in by Partnerships) for the first quarter?

maya: agree — safer to start conservative.

javier: agree. no objections.

tom: flagged a potential edge case: what about co-sell where SI brings a referral credit but no HW? propose referral calls for review but AE retains lead unless ARR threshold met.

kelly: noted. I'll add a 'referral_credit' boolean in the mapping table and default owner to AE unless ARR rule hits.

rachel: Action owner recap in one line please for the doc: Maya (intake + table), Javier (announce checklist), Kelly (SKU + rebate + referral flag), Alex (final signoff), Rachel (approve meeting). :white_check_mark:

alex: Perfect. Thanks all — we should reduce random DMs after this :pray:

partners-bot: New task created: PART-4821 "SI co-sell gate table + announce checklist" assigned to maya, javier, kelly, due 4 days. Link: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PART-4821
